kevin: Heads up, noticed a Vault namespace RBAC change rolled earlier that widened a rolebinding to `apps/*` and a CI job accidentally cached a KMS proxy token in logs. :rotating_light:
kevin: I already disabled the CI pipeline and removed the cached artifact, but we need a coordinated rotation and audit sweep.
maria: ugh. which KMS token? service account or proxy?
kevin: it's the ephemeral KMS-wrapped token our kms-proxy service issues for cross-project encrypt/decrypt. leaked value appears in `ci/build-logs/2027-10-12` (staging) and a few staging pods.
samir: can you paste the evidence (redact actual token) and the exact RBAC change diff? need to scope blast radius.
kevin: paste below (redacted):
```
2027-10-12T14:23:10Z INFO kms-proxy issuing wrapped_token=REDACTED for sa:projects/redwood/serviceAccounts/ci-runner@...
2027-10-12T14:24:02Z INFO pipeline cached artifact: kms_proxy_token=REDACTED
```
kevin: RBAC diff: `rolebinding.apps/ci-runner-binding` changed subjects from `svcaccount:ci-runner` -> `svcaccount:ci-runner, svcaccount:staging-*` (accidental pattern).
lina: timeline? who merged the RBAC change?
kevin: merged by `infra-bot` via config-sync at 14:22 UTC after an infra patch. I'll pull merge link and patch id.
maria: immediate actions I propose: 1) revoke all active wrapped tokens issued in last 3 hours, 2) rotate KMS wrapping key version (create new key version), 3) rotate any long-lived SA keys that might have been used to unwrap, 4) run audit query to list all vault/kv reads for the namespace.
samir: agree. add: search artifact storage (s3/gcs) for token-looking strings, and invalidate pipeline caches.
kevin: on it. I'm running audit queries now: `vault audit-log query --namespace=staging --since=3h --event=read`
kevin: devsec-bot: starting automated revoke for wrapped tokens issued between 14:00-15:00 UTC.
devsec-bot: acknowledged. queued revoke job id=R-20271012-01, ETA ~90s.
lina: who will rotate the KMS key? I can handle gcp side if someone rotates Vault rewrap config.
maria: assign Lina to KMS key rotation (create new key version + update IAM binding for unwrap role), Samir to Vault rewrap/update transit key mapping, Kevin to pipeline cache purge and RBAC revert.
oncall: I'm on standby for rollback if something breaks during rewrap. set oncall priority high.
kevin: I've put a temporary deny rule on config-sync to block further rolebinding pushes to `namespaces/staging` until we finish root-cause.
samir: steps for Vault: 1) create new transit key version `transit/staging/keys/v2`, 2) update `kv/wrap` rewrap config to use v2, 3) rewrap any records that used the old wrapping key (script below).
samir: script: ```bash
# list tokens to rewrap
vault list -format=json auth/token/accessors | jq -r '.[]' | while read acc; do
  # rewrap logic here (pseudocode)
  vault write transit/rewrap rewrap_accessor=$acc to_key=transit/staging/keys/v2
done
```
maria: we also need to update incident ticket and compliance log with who had access to RBAC merge. add timeline and proof. I opened INC-2027-453.
kevin: note: some staging pods wrote logs to GCS with higher retention. we should set retention-zero for those buckets or remove objects matching `kms_proxy_token` pattern.
lina: rotating SA keys: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys create` then remove old keys and update KMS unwrap IAM bindings. I'll coordinate with ops to update secrets in the private vault paths.
maria: after rotation run these checks: - audit log: no vault read for the leaked secret after revoke - pipeline: no cached artifacts containing token - app : error rate low after rewrap - compliance: key rotation recorded in KMS audit logs
kevin: ETA for revoke+cache purge ~10m. Lina ETA for KMS rotation 30m. Samir ETA for Vault rewrap 45m.
devsec-bot: revoke job R-20271012-01 completed: 32 wrapped tokens revoked, flagged 4 artifacts for deletion.
samir: rewrap started, running on a copy. will not rewrap sensitive live tokens until we confirm client compatibility.
lina: new key version created `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/staging/cryptoKeys/unwrap-key/versions/3`. updated IAM.
maria: good. please paste KMS audit entry ids once available for the ticket.
kevin: I've reverted the accidental rolebinding and queued a config-sync patch to delete the bad subject. patch id: cs-4132.
kevin: found 3 GCS objects containing token-like strings, removed and filed dmca deletion audit.
kevin: checklist to close: revoke ok, rotate KMS ok, rotate any SA keys used to unwrap ok, remove cached artifacts ok, audit confirmation ok, config-sync block removed after confidence.
samir: still need to decide on rotating customer-facing wrapped tokens vs ephemeral ones — we should prefer rewrap over mass rotate to avoid breaking sessions.
maria: compliance note: we need to notify SOC for potential disclosure and mark incident as P2 until we confirm no exfil.
oncall: monitoring: watch for auth failures in 5-15m post-rotate. I'll escalate if >0.5% errors.
lina: I pushed updated vault secret versions for `kv/staging/kms-proxy` pointing to new key version. CI jobs updated to pull new secrets.
devsec-bot: audit log snapshot saved to `gs://redwood-incidents/INC-2027-453/audit-snapshot-1923456789.json`
kevin: thanks all. will keep this thread live and paste final postmortem items when we have confirmation. :lock:
